				tooltip = COLDWAR_IRQ_provincial_agents_invoice_positive_presentation_tt
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_provincial_agents_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_IRQ_provincial_agents_invoice_funded_presentation_tt
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_provincial_agents_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_IRQ_presentation_treasury_payments_tt
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_IRQ_state_programme }
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_state_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = 0.05 tooltip = tax_gain_multiplier_modifier_tt }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_state_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 tooltip = bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt }
			}
			effect_tooltip = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.005 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_provincial_agents_quoted }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_provincial_agents_invoice }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				}
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			effect_tooltip = {  }
			hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_provincial_agents = yes }
		}
	}
